profile.headline: AI-first Software Engineer
profile.summary: AI-first engineer with experience in full stack development, machine learning, and blockchain. I also offer software engineering product and consulting services, see our website for more information and feel free to reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: AI and blockchain development group that brings forward nascent technology to underserved markets. We manage products full-cycle from ideation, MVP, to scaling. We also offer consulting to organizations looking to effectively utilize AI in their organization.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Consulting · Artificial Intelligence · Linux · Python · Ruby · Machine Learning

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
"Files.com is a unique cloud platform that empowers organization, collaboration, and insightful file logistics. We believe that files matter and that data should be secure, accessible, and easy to understand.

Our business is fully remote, profitable, and fast growing with more than 2,000 enterprise customers, small businesses, and governmental entities.

Want to learn more?
Please visit https://www.files.com/jobs/ or contact recruiting@files.com."
